instantiated_cells.justification: The statute creates criminal misdemeanor liability for knowing/willful violations (§91000(a)), authorizes fines (§91000(b)), provides civil liability for reporting violations up to the amount not properly reported (§91004) and up to $5,000 per violation where no specific civil penalty exists (§91005.5), and imposes a $10-per-day late-filing penalty capped at the greater of the amount stated or $100 (§91013).
The provided provisions address recordkeeping and enforcement actions but contain no requirement for regular audits or periodic independent auditing of lobbying disclosure records.
